title: Cap or rate limit reached: AffectionRateLimitExceeded
summary: Sourcify-verified custom error AffectionRateLimitExceeded indicates a hard cap, mint limit, daily limit, rate limit, or throttle blocked the action.
likelyCauses: The requested mint, transfer, borrow, bridge, or withdrawal exceeds a configured per-user or global cap.
A time-bucketed rate limit or daily limit has already been consumed.
The action would exceed max supply, market capacity, or protocol throughput limits.
nextSteps: Read the current cap, consumed amount, remaining allowance, reset time, and max supply.
